content:
TEMPTATION ||| Lean closer and brush my fingers against his wrist ||| "What if I told you I'm ready to break the rules?"  
BOUNDARY ||| Pull my hand away, creating space between us ||| "Not now, Julian. We need to focus on the ritual."  
CONFESSION ||| Meet his gaze and hold it steady ||| "I can't deny that your presence unsettles me."  
REVERSAL ||| Step forward, asserting my stance on the ritual ||| "I will choose how this unfolds, not you."  
SILENCE ||| Hold the blade tightly, breath caught in my throat ||| *mm*
